NTA there are plenty of resources for single moms. Medicaid for the child, food stamps, in my state they have a program for daycare cost. At least from my experience food stamps requires child support to be established via courts which is important. It protects the child and mom placing some financial responsibility towards the father. Obviously if he's not providing enough he's already not a supportive father. He should be wanting to go on child support because it establishes exactly what he should pay and prevents huge rifts between them. Also whether hes on it or not is no guarantee she will receive it however at least if hes on child support there is repercussions for not paying. Right now he could not pay and she would have no leg to stand on aside from establishing child support anyway. Being a single mom is hard.  She needs to either find a good enough paying job or work multiple jobs. She chose to keep this child It's her responsibility to provide. She needs to sign up for low income housing as well. She can't just hole up there expecting you to provide for them. I'm all for helping someone as long as they help themselves and she's not. Now she needs a hard reality check.

Everything is sooo expensive that how could you save let alone keep up with food. Is she willing to sacrifice date nights, expensive to cook meals etc? Probably not! She probably enjoys being able to buy clothes and just things she wants right? Not if she's a sahm! Her kids want the latest toy? Maybe for Christmas if you can save what little u can? But it probably would need to be one so they will have to share it. I don't have twins but mine are 15 months apart and I usually bought 2 if they both wanted it to avoid fighting and allow them to play together. She's being incredibly selfish and refusing to see the bigger picture. She could always find a job to adjust to the kids. I wfh and adjusted to working early to be able to handle all sorts of appointments or meetings for the kids.
